Question:
An eligible full-time hire starts January 19. On what date does their health, dental and vision coverage begin?

Retrieved context:

Title: Benefits Overview
Section: Health Benefits

Content:
Health Benefits

Northstar provides health, dental, and vision benefits to eligible full-time employees. Coverage begins on the first day of the month after the employee's start date. Plan details vary by employee location.

This overview does not include provider contracts, claim adjudication rules, or legal advice about benefits eligibility.

Onboarding Basics

New employees complete onboarding during their first 10 business days. Required onboarding includes security training, benefits enrollment, department orientation, and access review. Managers are responsible for assigning a buddy and scheduling the first 30-day check-in.

Employees should complete mandatory security awareness training before accessing customer data or production systems.

Content:
Vacation Entitlement

Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per calendar year. Vacation is accrued monthly and may be used after the employee's first 30 days of employment. Part-time employees receive prorated vacation based on scheduled weekly hours.

Employees may carry over up to 5 unused vacation days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by March 31 or they expire unless local law requires a different outcome.

Wellness Stipend

Eligible full-time employees receive a wellness stipend of 750 CAD or 550 USD per calendar year, based on payroll country. The stipend may be used for fitness memberships, mental health apps, ergonomic equipment, or wellness programs.

Unused wellness stipend amounts do not carry over into the next calendar year.
